theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_rc_ball_cone_measurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (α q : ℝ), SFinite μ → Measurable ν → Measurable (fun x : Euclid (m + 1) => μ (closedBall x q)) ∧ Measurable (fun x : Euclid (m + 1) => μ ({z | α * ‖z - x‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - x) (ν x)|} ∩ closedBall x q))
